t:
Its possibilities are not known to me... yet. This place was born in the exact same moment as me. Just as I am beginning to unfold my wings, the Observatory is still expanding its horizons.

However, it already has one property that we may use. Every mighty opponent that any hero of Sarnaut had ever faced left its imprint in the world. Those imprints entice the Observatory. It wants to relive those moments over and over again, feel the taste of time, understand its course and its laws... The Observatory rewards those who can help it learn.

You will find four Whirls here, and each one conceals one enemy. How long each of them are going to stay there is a mystery to me. The Observatory might get bored and replace them by the next time you are back.

The Observatory made its choice:

First Whirl: The Dead King.

Second Whirl: Kazul.

Third Whirl: Nihil.

Fourth Whirl: Thalos.

The Observatory made its choice:

First Whirl: Kanaan, Blood Father.

Second Whirl: Clockwork Knight, Catherina's Guardian.

Third Whirl: Brainum the Third, Treasury Keeper.

Fourth Whirl: Eurial, Forgotten Goddess.

Yes, Hedus-Avior-Mirach is what they called me when I was whole! The river of time carried those days away. Nihaz imprisoned me here a long time ago. He used me as a power source for this Citadel and all sorts of operations. I resisted for as long as I could, but in the end, I lost myself in this prison. Curse Nihaz to eternal damnation! Thank you for freeing me. Now I can become one with eternity... Farewell.
Let's go. This goblin had an idea.
Something is spinning in the center of the device.
The portal is not very stable, but it can teleport you a short distance to save you some time.
Before you stand the gates to Sardrok, and beyond them lies the domain of the sinister Old Man.
Travelers are advised to leave this gloomy place before it's too late.
You can sense a strange pulsation of energy...
You can sense a strange pulsation of energy...
Can't you just walk there?.. Oh, alright...
Can't you just walk there?.. Oh, alright...
Hurry up, we don't have much time.
Don't chat too much. We don't have time.

This is a curious story. Their sparks first met at Tep's Pyramid. Now they meet in person.

I guess you are the cause of this meeting. You have been able to make the Astral do, what you need. You needed allies, and they came to the rescue. Your will, plus Sarn's power, plus their own conscience - and there you go.

You don't have to worry about the consequences. As soon as you leave this place, they will disappear. Simple, like that.

I outsmarted myself. I studied Skrakan's archives in search for the source of power. He described a strange event in Gorluxor's Tower, when a strong demon appeared out of nowhere... Just imagine all the energy! Unbelievable magic and supreme technologies! I could bring the world back to peace, take it under full control and power...

Only it wasn't just another random demon. It was one of the first children of Sarn, his own Avatar, created during the times of June Curse. While I thought I was bringing him under my control, it was seizing my consciousness. This is why I happen to help the Leper spread...

The Leper is just another side of creation. This is life, made of the very same primal matter. The only difference is that it's able to corrupt other forms of life. Sarn has gone mad. His gift of the Creator now serves the evil and makes his wicked fantasies come true.

While my mind was under control, I was able to touch his consciousness, but never dared. I was scared by an ocean of madness and malice...
You're more stubborn than I'd thought.

It's unimaginable! Just one little shard of Sarn's soul, encased in the avatar he created himself - what a huge power it turned out to conceal! He could have done so much with this power, but he preferred his pathetic attempts to break free... You know, I think I nearly pity him. Hm, it's not typical for me.

This is the Seal. If you could only sense all the primal, natural magic here! It's under our feet, and all around us! If you could only understand, how tempting it is... but I do not dare touching it. I've learned my lesson. Nihaz, who created the Seals, was a way stronger and craftier than Sarn. Oh, even if the God of Light strived to conform to him, we can only guess, what the God of Darkness was apt to perform...

We'd better leave this place. It's not good for mortal beings.

I am going to return to Skytower and make it right. My allod is my prison now, just like the Seals are prison to Sarn. I'm not mad, though, and I'm not going to try and break my prison!

I will have to make peace between the pagans and the followers of the Light. I must admit, outcasts acted their best at this war... Besides, if it weren't for them, you would have never reached this place. Establishing peace won't be easy. I will have to engage all diplomacy I can, and at the same time, to make sure that neither Empire nor League have their fingers in my pie! My play is too artful to let them into it. The Leper - a common enemy - will unite us... and they don't need to know that it's so weak now, that it's no danger at all for neither of the sides.

What next? Only time can tell. This union might help Umoir prosper... As to you, you certainly deserve my gratitude. Thank you for showing me many unexpected things. Believe me, it's not so easy, given all my experience.

Go now. Leave me. I have to give it all a deep thought...
Way down leads to the treasury.
The doors lead to the Castle Hall.
The doors open with a quiet squeak.
The gates open with a quiet squeak.
The heavy doors are elaborately carved.
The doors open with a quiet squeak.
The heavy gates are intricately carved.
The gates lead to Winter Palace - the tycoon's residence, captured by Hoof's bandits and the followers of the mad prophet.
Use the Portal to teleport to any port of the Castle.
The door leads back to the stairs.
The doors open with a quiet squeak.
The heavy gates are intricately carved.

Behind these gates is what the fanatics call the Ascension Hall. Here the followers of the crazy Prophet created monstrous chimeras out of parts of Architects and humans. But what is the final purpose of the Sculptor who stands behind the fanatics? The answer is near - we just need to open the door...

What is waiting for you behind the door? Maybe, you should just open it a little first and take a quick glance inside? However, if the fanatics don't scare you, you can just kick it open and take your enemies by surprise.
The door goes off its hinges with a rattle.
The doors open with a quiet squeak.
These doors lead to the castle treasury. Looks like Hoof decided to literally live on his gold!
Hoof will not surrender voluntarily - first you will have to beat him up!
The door goes off its hinges with a rattle.
The doors open with a quiet squeak.
The heavy doors are elaborately carved.
The doors open with a quiet squeak.
Are you ready to hear the Prophet's word of the New Order that will come after the Ascension?
Enter and listen, for a believer's word is an uncut diamond, and a wise man's word is a shining gem!

I am the official representative of the Free Traders in Nezebgrad. According to my contract with the City Council, I have an exclusive right to buy up and resell valuables obtained in the Astral, Distortions, and Skirmishes.

You can become my regular customer, but with one condition. The great leader Yasker encourages all heroes to unite in the name of common cause. This is why the program of mutual help has been developed. Let me explain to you how it works. As we have learned from history, everybody chooses their own way to serve the Empire. Some control the monsters' population on allods, some eliminate the external threat in the Astral, some fight for the Empire in local conflicts with the League... and other enemies. All those heroes bring a part of their rewards to me and trade them for special coins, which, in their turn, can be traded for other valuables. That's a very useful initiative!

The Free Traders have entrusted me with running their honorable business here. I redistribute trophies among fine heroes of the League. Yes, those rewards that you obtain in the Astral, Distortions, and Skirmishes.

I would gladly share all this with you, but you have to pay the price. The times are hard, so we should stand shoulder to shoulder and help each other so that everyone can get some great equipment and weapons. It's pretty simple - some clear allods of all sorts of monsters, some explore the depths of the Astral, some shed their blood in battles with the Empire... and other enemies. All those heroes bring a part of their loot to me to receive special coins for that, and use them to buy valuables obtained by other heroes. Everybody's happy! Isn't that great?

On behalf of the Free Traders, I salute you!

Let me remind you that the prices are flexible and change depending on the demand. Purchased goods are non-refundable!

The Free Traders welcome you!

Remember that the prices are flexible and change depending on the demand. Purchased goods are non-refundable!
Sing and dance, dance and sing!
I have only the best goods!
I have only the best goods!
New loot from the graves! Just kidding, don't worry!
Happy Intercession day! Let the Light bestow its blessings upon thee!
I have only the best goods!
Done! You can do all daily quests of the holiday again!
Take a rest from battle, feast and make merry! With Swordring!
Do not forget to congratulate Aidenus!
You can buy a permanent Lobster for 12 Platinum coins or trade it for a temporary Lobster and 2 coins. You can exchange your temporary Lobster through the Stable.

Citizens of the Empire! Today we celebrate the birthday of a person without whom there would be no Empire! The great leader, who led the Empire to prosperity and united under his rule the proud Xadaganians, the powerful Orcs, and the Arisen, to create a great nation! A person who personally fought against the demons during the Night of Astral Portals, and emerged victorious!
So we congratulate our constant leader, the Great Yasker with all our hearts, and wish him eternal health!
And you, if you like, can acquire some souvenirs of the holiday and some gifts from me.
Don't forget to congratulate Yasker! You'll see, he'll be happy!
Done! You can do all daily quests of the holiday again!
I've got the best goods for adventurers!

Ugra-Xada is a very old word... Not many Xadaganians remember why their favorite holiday is called so.
Thousands years ago, before our world was shattered, the Great Nezeb left Kania, a state that was immersed in sin and vice. He met proud and honest nomadic tribe in the southern steppes. These skilled horsemen and fearless warriors called themselves the people of Ugra. They believed they were descendants of an ancient god Ugra. When Nezeb defeated their leader in an honest fight, nomads believed that he was god. The great Xadaganian state was born that day.
I'm offering special holiday items to Xadaganians during the celebration.
Remember the history of your state and be proud of it!

Sabantuy is a traditional orcish holiday. In the olden times, when the orcs were wild and led a nomadic life in the vast steppes, only once a year all the orcish tribes would gather for a celebration. Mighty fighters would compete in crushing rocks with their bare hands, drinking up barrels of beer on a wager, and hammering each other on the head until only the toughest orc with the strongest forehead would remain on his feet. The winner would earn a war club as a reward, as well as the respect of the tribe. A lot has changed since. The orcs have become esteemed citizens of the Empire, but the tradition of celebrating Sabantuy remains.
When the holiday rolls around, the orcs still drink beer by the bucket, hammer each other on the head with ritual clubs, make lots of noise and fun, and, of course, play their favorite game, goblinball. Besides, any orc that visits an artisan during the celebration can become a lucky owner of valuable gifts and souvenirs.

Opening of the Eyes and Lips was a burying ritual among the ancient Zem when the deceased person was symbolically reborn for the afterlife. The ritual gave the name to the day when the Arisen celebrate their return to life. Don't expect to hear the thunder of salutes and drunken shouting: the Arisen don't like wild celebrations much. Meditations, reflections and discussions about science and future of mankind are more to their liking. On that day, however, even they can't help but pamper themselves with wonderful holiday souvenirs!
I have special goods for alchemists today!
Congratulations, merry blacksmith! Now, what item is to your liking?
Best goods from the best tailors!
Congratulations, merry weaponsmith! Now, which item is to your liking?
Take your pick. Today I've got special items for all Scouts!
Remember your history and take pride in it, citizen!
Sorry, you don't have enough money.
Hello! If you want to learn about Imperial holidays, I'll be glad to tell you! If you visit me during a celebration that applies to you, I will sell you special holiday items.

A Prophetic Card is a valuable item. If you are lucky enough, it will reward you generously.
But the card itself will not reveal its secrets. In order to decipher it and receive your prize, you should buy an Ancient Compass from the Boutique. You may also choose to delve deeper into the secrets of the card by spending more Compasses and receive additional rewards. Your chance of winning a top prize increases with each attempt.
Your future is obscure, and even the Ancient Compass cannot guide you. This is not a good moment to play with fate. I will highlight the time when you can use the Prophetic Card in your calendar.

Oh! A Prophetic Card is a rare and valuable item.

If you are lucky enough, even one card might reward you generously. Why, of course! You can't toy with destiny!

It's not that simple, though. The card will not reveal its secrets by itself. In order to decipher it and receive your prize, you should buy an Ancient Compass from the Boutique. You may also choose to delve deeper into the secrets of the card by spending more Compasses and receive additional rewards.

Your chance of winning the grand prize increases with each attempt. Go for it, and may the odds be ever in your favor.

Hm... Your future is obscure, and even the Ancient Compass cannot help you. This is not a good moment to toy with fate.

I will highlight the time when you can use the Prophetic Card in your calendar.

T92 Arty's job is to damage Maus. But first, Maus must be highlighted by one of the T50-2 Fireflies. Use the Aim ability to increase the accuracy of your shots. Camouflage ability helps avoid danger.
Tanks are combat vehicles developed by our engineers in the secret military labs. Choose the one you prefer and go ahead!

Should you need help in combat, I will aid you using the communication device.
Choose your tank and join the battle!
IS-7 Heavy is slow and sturdy tank used to disable Maus. Aim to its vulnerable spots - turret, sights or tracks, and shoot!
My team of engineers created this mechanical monster, but now I pray that you will stop it!
T50-2 Firefly is light and fast, but once it started moving it may not stop, otherwise the heat will blow out the engine. T50-2 mission is to highlight Maus, enabling T92 Arty to shoot.
T14 Polite is a universal tank which can easily take down Stumps and GiWis and even breach Maus' armor with a piercing shot. Polite's active shield protects it from Maus's direct fire.

It is sad that things turned that way. We never intended to use Maus in combat; it was supposed to be a weapon of deterrence... And now our creation has rised against us! Some insane goblin is grinding the allod to dust in the name of "revolution"!
Luckily, we have other combat vehicles at our disposal. They are weaker than Maus in one-on-one combat, but smart teamwork will help you succeed.
There are coffers with construction materials and precious metals spread across the Summerhold. As you know, goblins are crazy about shiny baubles, so Maus' driver will attempt to destroy the coffers and collect the resources. You must defeat Maus before all coffers are gone!

T92 Arty can shoot from a huge distance and inflict incredible damage, but it is as accurate as a drunk gibberling. The good thing is, if T50-2 Firefly highlights the target for Arty, it will increase the accuracy greatly. Note that if Arty misses, the ground is engulfed in flame which damages allied tanks.

Experimental engine of this tank is boosted and requires constant flow of air from movement to cool down. Firefly is the only tank that can highlight Maus to increase the accuracy of other tank shots. Firefly has no armor and can be destroyed with a single shot. Wrecked, it leaves a patch of burning fuel which damages the allied tanks!

The latest product of Nezeb Cart Factory! A universal vehicle which can fire swiftly and precisely, and its armor-piercing shells can even make a hole in Maus' skin.

It also has an active shield. It is useless against GiWi and Stumps, but it can save you from direct Maus' shots.

This tank is strong enough to disable Maus temporarily: a precise shot to a track pins Maus down, damaging the sights prevents the steel monster from shooting, and hitting the turret surely draws the attention of Maus' driver! But remember that due to slow speed, IS-7 is vulnerable in the open.
Type 59 ST is a well-rounded tank designed for mass production, fast and strong enough to break through the Maus' armor.
Type 59 ST is a support tank whose main task is hunting down Maus' minions - Type 704 Stump and GiWi Type E. Only ST is capable of breaking through their defenses.

Want to make some extra cash? No problem, but you bear all the risks if cargo exceeds weight limits. Essentially, you pay for ore crates, then sell them to the hangar merchants and split the profits amongst yourself and your crew!
Uninterrupted supplies of meteorite iron are crucial. If you deliver the meteorite ore safe and sound, you'll get a generous reward! And remember, the more supplies you deliver, the happier we'll be.
Where are we supposed to load those crates, on your back? The hold is already full!
Where are we supposed to load those crates, on your back? The hold is already full!

Want to make some extra cash? No problem, but you bear all the risks if cargo exceeds weight limits. In short, you pay for the supplies, then sell them to the supplier and split the profits amongst yourself and your crew!

Excellent! Now, just deliver the cargo to one of our suppliers, unload it and grab your reward. Remember, you can load as many supplies as you want. You might just as well stuff the entire hold. The supplier will pay for everything in full. You can even "load" the cargo from enemy ships, wink wink... And if you take the meteorite iron cargo on your way back, your earnings will double.
Not enough room in your ship's treasure room! Free up some space or we'll load your flagship right up to the mast.
Where are we supposed to load them, on your back? Bring the ship into the hangar first before giving loading orders!
It's a pity you refuse to deliver the cargo. But you have your reasons, I get it... You've been reimbursed for the money spent on purchases.
It's a pity you refuse to deliver the cargo. But you have your reasons, I get it... You've been reimbursed for the money spent on purchases.
Outstanding! Supplies of meteorite iron are paid for generously - {Price} per crate!
Excellent! I'll pay {Price} per crate. Moreover, I'll give you all a bonus for long distance delivery.
Welcome! We are in dire need of supplies to continue working, and we'll pay handsomely for the delivery. Just unload them from the hold and bring me the delivery certificate.
What do you want to know?
Ready! Next time that you summon your ship, you will be able to rename it!
Congratulations! Your ship is finished. It's now ready to travel the Astral.
The repairs are completed. Your ship is ready to travel once again.

Your ship is coming along nicely.

I'm sure you'll be very pleased when it's finished!
We're repairing your ship as fast as possible. You can cancel the repairs at any time, but all materials that have already been spent will be lost.

Do you want to rename your ship? Not a problem!

But there will be a lot of paperwork, and it will cost you. You can do it only once a day!

And of course, you will have to summon the ship.

You can now change your ship's devices.

When you're on board, select the device you want to change and select the replacing one.

In this mode, your ship will not operate and all other devices will be disabled. Don't forget to turn it off before you depart.
Here it is, your future ship!
Remember that while the repairs are being completed you can't take your ship out of the hangar. You can cancel the repairs at any time, but all materials that were spent will be lost.
Alright, your ship's devices are no longer being changed. The ship is now ready to travel!
Your ship is ready for travel or maintenance.
Are you sure you want to unsummon your ship? All treasures that remain on it will be lost.
Your ship has been removed from the hangar.
Decaying particles are not so valuable as those obtained in the Mysterious Astral, still we're willing to trade special goods for them.

Choose whatever item you like and use it to destroy dozens more demons!

Greetings!
Not so long ago, a breakthrough discovery has opened up a pathway to a distant, unexplored Astral. This Astral lacks the familiar allods, shows no reflections of heroic adventures, and there are no clear routes of travel.
Instead it is full of bizarre phenomena, anomalies, and strange creatures that have never been encountered in the nearer layers of the Astral. Who knows what kind of danger lurks there? Demon Hunters consider it their duty to destroy any threat that might be hiding there, and they will use everything at their disposal in the pursuit of this goal.
During your travels in this distant Astral, you might meet powerful demons. Having defeated a demon, you'll be able to use an astral trap to capture its body's astral essence. You will also find unstable anomalies, either just-forming or in the process of disintegrating, and these can be captured as well.

Bring me any anomalous emanations you've collected in the far Astral and you will be able to trade them for rare items or special equipment. For each 100 killed demons you will receive a Treasure Chest, which I can exchange for Transforming Crystals or components for crafting Glyphs.

Welcome to the Astral hangar! What can I help you with?

You already have 28 Teleport Charges and cannot carry more.
You don't have enough money to buy a Teleport Charge
You are not allowed to access the Pilot Chart. Access is granted along with the keys.
Welcome to the Astral hangar! What can we help you with?

Damaged ships should be repaired after returning to the hangar. I can help you with this process, but you will need to bring me the proper materials before it can begin.
The repair process can take some time. The duration depends on the extent of the damage. However, the repair process can be accelerated by completing special tasks. You can check on the progress that's been made by talking to me at any time! I'll be happy to keep you updated.
The repair process ends automatically if you depart to the Astral. And if the ship has been repaired to full, you can simply summon it and proceed with your travels.
Now you can fly with your allies as much as you want. You won't spend keys or get any loot at the Isle, though.
Enough is enough. Ah well, one cannot sponge off their friends forever! Now you will be spending your keys and receive loot again!
Greetings, captain! If you wish the ship repaired, a couple of holes patched or the rug in the captain's cabin changed - just whistle!

You can choose any of the voyage routes we offer. Our voyages will allow you to fully enjoy Sarnaut's beauty.
The ship sets out in 30 seconds after you choose a route. You don't have to steer the ship during the voyage. Where are we heading?

Greetings, captain! Do you wish to drop anchor at the pier? Then you'll need a special pass. You can get it at the auction held every last week of the month. The five most generous captains will proudly exhibit their ships to the public and enjoy the comfort of an open pier for a month. Do you want all the other captains to envy your beautiful ship? Then good luck at the auction!
Welcome! I'm Nickolas Booksy. Who are you? Oh, it doesn't really matter. We need your help, whoever you are.
The frog stares at you sadly. You recall tales of spellbound princesses... Why don't you try and kiss her?

Look at it! Someone must be tired of all the killing and decided to join a simple lumberjack? To what do I owe this honor? Ah... You’re looking at the tobacco. Yes, it’s an unusual one. Can you feel the smell? That’s right! Strawberry! Tobacco smelling as real strawberry, can you believe that? I bought it from the Imperial traders. To add strawberry to tobacco... What a cruel thing to do! What will be next? Anyway, do you want to fish with me? I’m kind of bored here on my own. Do you want to try the tobacco, too? Alright, but first you must roll up your pants.
You came here to hear my new single?
Huh? What? What's up? Who're you?
Oh holy camoly! Oh them demons! Let's go give 'em hell!
What a hot day it is. Roll on, our guys're in trouble!
I hope they'll hold out till we come...
Who the hell are you? Why must I give you rides? Ah, you're heroes! We'll see what kind of heroes you are. See those zombies and toads along the coastline? Show me how brave you are, kill them all!
Alright, I can do that, if you insist. I've only got one rule: I don't ferry the living one, only ghouls.
Oh, very well, you win. Come on.
I can smell the human breath! What are you seeking here?
I can't believe my eyes! The living souls! Go on, tell me what has happened! Where are we? What is this starry, endless space around us?

Thank goodness, someone has managed to stay alive after the Cataclysm... How's it going in a broken world thousand years after? Is the great House de Tristesse prospering? Never heard of it? Ah, this is rather sad...
How I would love to leave this damned land... But my dreams are so vain. Everything that this land holds is in Sage's power. And thus it will be, until he is defeated.
He was a real menace - a necromancer by vocation, a capturer by nature, he gathered an army of the undead and unleashed war against his neighbors. The latters were lucky to defeat him and his army.
The army was beaten hollow, Sage himself was buried, and the grave was enchanted so that he could never rise again. Time passed, the enchantment faded, and finally Sage turned able to revive himself and the deadmen on the graveyard.
You have to defeat him right away, before he regains full power, otherwise it will be trouble!

Sage is in command here. He's the wraith in armor of steel, he's the ghost of a mighty necromancer. He arose all deadmen on this cemetery from their graves.
Hell Sheer is his number two. He's the head of the epic heroes squad - four captured souls of the four knights for him to leech force from. Destroy their graves to deprive Sheer of control over them.
Sage's other servant is Nergthrut Legpuller. During his lifetime he was a real stalwart: sturdy, merry and smart. His sense of humor grew nasty over the years, though. He once swapped fireworks for real explosives just for fun, and was blown sky high along with the other victims of the practical joke. If you make up your mind to fight him, listen carefully to his gags and play along: giggle or weep, just make him burst out laughing - then seize the moment to hit him hard!
As long as the Ferryman is concerned, I know nothing about him. Nothing at all. He's weird and grim. I'm not even sure if he's serving Sage or he's only pretending to do so. Make sure to keep your eyes open!

Sage made slaves out of all the dead people that had been buried here, all of them. He hasn't got me, though, for I know a thing or two about wizardry! But he's getting stronger day by day, so it won't be long till he reaches out and grabs me to join his ghostly team...
I'm not the one who stands. There is a trader Boris Greedoff. He'd already been under a curse, so Sage failed to entrap him. Boris used to be a scrooge in the old days, a real grabber, drained dry whole villages, so people finally laid a curse on him. His soul is restless till he returns all the misbegotten. And by the way, he'd nearly done so, and could free his soul, when the world broke apart!
Here's a handful of Holy Ground. Find the trader's mausoleum and scatter it around. You can't miss it, it's really huge. As soon as Boris arrives, accept his gold and may he rest in peace. He's suffered enough.
I've been dwelling here for thousand years... Take this gold, but release me, I beg you!
Take it all, take it all! Yuppie, I'm free!
The tombstone is covered with mud and dust.
You fail to read the ancient elven letters on the tombstone, but a ghostly figure slowly condenses from the thin air.
You can see the energy pulsing.
You can see the energy pulsing.

My heart is aching! Dark and sad was the day when the Tekyan met the one who carries the Light. If only she could go away with you! At first, she attempted to broker a peace between the two settlements, but then...  You can see how this all ended. Tekyan are spilling Tekyan blood, and I can't protect them! I cannot raise my hand against my friends! I am helpless here, so you are their only hope. I beg you, please put an end to this fight! You have saved the Tekyan from false gods before – do it again!
Dushman, gitmek! You have selected your destiny! Your blood will turn into poison!

Oh... It turns out to have been real... I thought I was dreaming about a snake that bit me, and then you woke me up... It was not a dream, then!

Alas, what am I going to do now? For the sake of all the world's riches, leave now. Leave, please. I want to be alone.

What?! How dare you defame noble Mehmet Pasha?! My father has no friend who is more loyal and trustful, than the Grand Vizir! Do you have evidence? If you fail to prove it, you will be thrown into boiling oil... alive!

A letter? What a familiar handwriting... I cannot believe it, it cannot be!

Leave me. Here's for your service... and leave me now. Father, I can't believe it, how could this ever happen...

Guards! Take these ruffians and throw them into zindan! No, better chop their heads off! And then boil them in hot oil!

Guards, where are you? Help!
Save us, I beg of you! Janizary shut the bridge and rob everyone they see. Sultan's gone missing, Vizir is passive... We've got no hope, but you!

Hallelujah, we're saved! May your name be praised in centuries!

Janizary went out of control, when Sultan turned out to be missing. May the Lord forgive my words, but I think, it's the Grand Vizir who gave Janizary order to keep us low and quiet. Oh, I'd rather have my tongue cut off, than find out that this is the bitter truth...
No! I say no! I won't go anywhere without a Christmas tree!
What do you think? I need to find a damned Christmas tree! My wife told me not to come home without it. And I better do what she says...

Don't you see, eh? I've been bewitched! I snagged a wand from the hut. It turned out to be a magic one!

Do you happen to know how to use magic wands? Can you unspell me?

It's too small! Do you hear me? Too small!!

Take this magic stick. I don't know how it works. Take it and conjure me a Christmas Tree! And a big one!
What's the good of it now... It's spring already! Now I will have to carry it all the way back!
What a Christmas Tree! The queen of Christmas Trees! My wife has to see it!
Well... May it be so! I will reduce you to ashes!

I'm afraid I do not deserve mercy. The misdeeds that I caused are beyond redemption.

But I still love him! If I had to do it all again, I'd do the same thing. And you... You killed Alister! You killed my beloved one! And now you have to die!
There is excuse for my misdeeds, just as there is no forgiveness for you! Kill me or die!

So this is it... The walking dead gave me away, right? Sad to hear...

Well, may it be so. Do you want to listen to my story, or are we getting straight down to the business?

I loved Alister... I was ready to do anything for his love!

I turned Mstislav into a werewolf to keep the peasants in their homes even when the sun is up. My beloved one can't stand the daylight!

Then I lured the Inquisitors into the old town and lied to them about the ancient evil in the ruins. They wanted to kill my darling!

And I spoiled the ritual by adding the dead man's blood to the ritual bowl. All for the love, all for him!

And he... He betrayed me! I gave him my heart, and he trampled on it! He forgot my love at the moment when he stopped needing me...
These ancient June ruins are overflowing with magic...
These ancient June ruins are overflowing with magic...
These ancient June ruins are overflowing with magic...
The ruins are silent... It seems that it needs to be activated with some kind of a key.

The Portal network of the Sorcery Workshop is still working - June magic is reliable, as always. However, to activate the rest of the Portals, you will first have to reach them.

Where do we go?
Your foot hit against an invisible obstacle. Some evil force must be guarding this idol.
Oops! Quag doesn't seem to like it...

The chaotic scribblings can hardly be read, and you can only decipher short phrases.

"...reactor is dead... ttacked the rock... four surviv..."

"...hiding in the thicket... lying... collect bodies... to eat!"

"...isle is cursed... bosun gone to the jungle... howls and croak..."

"...one more ship... hull is crushed... killed everyone! They killed everyone! Damn savag..."

"...saw my friend... dea... came for me!"
Half-decomposed remains obviously belonged to the shipboy. Several sheets of paper are scattered around his body - it looks like he tried to write a note before he died.

Clustered pages of the book are covered with tiny neat handwriting - incomings, expenses, balance, wages... Nothing interesting. But there is a scratchy drawing on the last page. It depicts a stone with a giant toad-like figure hovering above it, and a group of people at the foot of the stone, surrounded by some weird creatures.
The sailor's bones are picked bare by the local fauna. A spine of a book is protruding out of the hole in his belt bag.

It's a fragment of a logbook, stained with blood. Looks like the devices of the ship that tried to moor to the allod suddenly went dead, and the ship crushed into the rocks.

The back of the sheet reads: "They will find us! They will devour us all! Quag wants our blood!"
The skeleton is squeezing a piece of paper in its bony hand.
This ugly idol is spreading the vibe of hunger and malice!

Those who wish to use the Portal net of the city should first visit all places of interest in East Overshoe.

Where would you like to go?
The Portal is closed due to quarantine. to restore its operation, first activate the connected portals.

The Portal network of the Forgotten temple is still working - June magic is reliable, as always. However, to activate the rest of the Portals, you will first have to reach them.

Where do we go?

The Historians' camp is destroyed, and everyone who was there is dead... Except for this creature. I wonder where it came from?

The one thing I can see is that it's really, really hungry.

What do we do?
The Dragon swallowed the food in an instant. It looks like he's already in love with his feeder.
The Dragon clumsily gets out of the eggshell and shows you that he is ready to follow you to the depths of Astral.

The Dragon’s bones crack in your hands.

You feel a mysterious power that fills you. There is something evil about that power...
The Dragon happily purrs and drums his wings. It was not a good idea to burn a Fire Dragon.

This must be the journal of the expedition trapper. He writes about exotic birds and exotic diseases, but there are also his personal notes:

"The egg moves more and more often. Looks like it is resistant to the cold... I hope it doesn't die after it hatches. I don't want to burn the rest of my fur in attempt to obtain another egg. And we won't come to the Dragon Ring again any time soon."

"I saved some food - fire Dragon cubs are always hungry. I hope our cook's dishes are edible and we don't end up in Great Yao."

The book cover reads that this is the journal of Gregory Hlestin, one of the researchers. The pages are covered with his neat handwriting and are full of official language. It looks more like a battle log than a diary. However, the last entry says...

"Nezeb as my witness, today that comet has approached the allod closer than ever. Saad-Croy may say whatever he wants about my eyes getting old... My eyes! The eyes of the best Imperial Cannoneer! What a lame joke.

Elementals are behaving strangely. Supposedly, the comet stimulates their activity. We should reinforce the patrol.

Apart from the above-mentioned, no

...

WE ARE UNDER ATTACK!

THEY ARE WORMFACES!"

Looks like a lab log. Nothing really interesting - just analysis of mineral samples and copies of carved drawings from the ruins. From underneath the ornamented cover, a note peers out.

"Sveta! Meet me downstairs! My shift's at three."

Sounds like a promising message from an Orc guardian. Does love know no limits?

Another researcher's diary. This one looks like a compilation of random thoughts and speculations. The author seems to have been too absorbed with his work to make proper records.

"Almost two thirds of the temple are destroyed and dissolved in the Astral. But the arenas are still there. The nature of force fields (?) is unclear..."

"Weird devices that look like stone calendars (?) serve as portals between the destroyed parts of the allod. They look newer than everything else (?). SUSPICIOUS."

"Strange flares coming from somewhere around the volcano. It will be funny if it decides to wake up."

"We found weapons. A lot of them. It seems that THEY (?) used the temple to train fighters (?). We need to find a way to reach the volcano. Using the ship is way too dangerous."

"The guards report that they saw some creatures next to the bottom of the volcano last night. (?)"
New Bay is a small city, and Aoidoi use the local transport net instead of Astral cannons. Where would you like to go?

The Demon is impatiently shaking his sword... If that terrifying weapon can be called so.

The invasion doesn't seem to bother him at all.
The Demon makes a sound that can be interpreted as an approving harrumph.
The small Demon is lost in his small demonic thoughts. He doesn't seem to notice anything around him.

The Demon growls aggressively.

Come to think of it, one can even call it cute.
Datura's charms have lost their power. You can leave this cursed place at any time.

So, that's how it goes, eh? Ah, well, a favor for a favor, that's the rule. I haven't slept for a long while. All these forest animals... wouldn't let me sleep. Prowling, rattling, munching all the time... Rid me of 'em, and I'll give you the shard.
Look what the stupid wind blew in!.. So many of you! What are you looking for in my forest?
That's how it goes then? Well, I guess, I'll have to get rid of you personally.

The shard? You know, the Silent Sentinels have only got a single duty - to maintain order at the cemetery. Look, how many ghouls are walking around. Make sure they find the eternal peace, and I'll give you the artifact.
Look at the living flesh! Haven't seen it in a while.
Now it is your turn! The Silent Sentinels will stand forever!
A fragment of inscription can still be seen on the ancient monument: "...it will preserve this city's peace and protect its citizens forever."
The stone monument is standing still.

My experiments are over... By sheer luck, I managed to create a truly magnificent thing. This item... It is a crystal that conceals power beyond anything I had witnessed so far. It can control the structure of things, changing their properties and perhaps even their magical essence! If my assessments are correct, this artifact will serve our city well.

The crystal is amazing, but its power is scaring me. Great power carries with it great unpredictability. All the challenges we have faced during the last years... The plague, awakening of the dead... Is it the crystal to blame? Is it my fault? I must stop the influence, find a way to destroy it.
The crystal seems to be sane. I could break it into four parts, but at a great price. The city is deserted. Streets smell like death. Very few people were able to escape. As for me... my end is near.
Oh come on now, you've already sent all the lads away! You get to work and deal with that rat after all!

Sure will! I'll be tellin' my buddies to grab anything edible and drag it along to the cafeteria. They'll be feeding your critter a bit so it doesn't eat your own sorry selves while you're dealing with it. Hehe.
You gotta help us out first!

Right. The dutyman's armband is both power and risk.

The horrors fear and hate the dutymen. Sometimes, fallen enemies are trying to curse the dutyman to make him more vulnerable. But that gives him more strength to defeat new enemies.

And if the comrades are nearby, the curse would afflict them as well. That's how it is!

Are you ready to take on the dutyman's armbands?

Receiving!
Not a problem! There are heroes not only among the dutymen. Correctly gauging the strength of your squad is the key.

A true pioneer's response!

Onward, the squad on duty! Get the Mirage rid of this menace!
I'm not a fighter, but there's something I can do. Here, take this portable lightning arrester. It will prevent you from burning on the spot.

Those cultists, they beat me up and left me for dead! I would have become a source material for replicants. Thank you for saving me! Now it's time to take urgent measures.

There's a lever down the corridor, it summons guards. They'll help you clear the lab of the cultists.
There's a testing lab where we used to perform experiments on reviving dead bodies. The cultists have sewn up a huge carcass and are trying to animate it!
Long story short, there was a catastrophe. I can tell you more...
Well, all I can tell you is good luck!
You don't look like a squad dispatched by the City Council... Are you the reinforcements?

You should know that the Animality Potion is so last century! We're experimenting with meldonium-based serums. Theoretically, we may obtain a formula that will allow to knock the world flat. Literally.

Would you like to try one of our latest prototypes? We were in the middle of testing it when cultists started their operation. We lost all data, now we'll have to collect it all over again...

Yes, we will. A scientist must remain scientist in all situations.

Are you alive?! Are your Sparks free of the Stele's power? You can save us all! Both our armies, the League and the Empire, are caught in a trap. Sparks of everyone who died in this battle are controlled by this awful device on the hill. Destroy it and free our Sparks!
Great! But now there’s fire from the shore.

Now, if you wanna help, here's the list of those who you must invite to the party.

First, it's Fith the Forester, a Blue Corporal from Igsh Military District. He's a real man, always ready to fight! Can't even remember when I last saw him without bruises on his face...

Second, it's Shildar the Wily, a Red Captain... you got me, right? That's gonna be some show, right? Don't tell anyone, though. I don't want the joke to be spoiled.

And third, it's Marianna Preminina, IMD Commissar. Real headstrong woman with an iron fist! But I can tell everyone will be glad to see her here.

All clear? To the rear! March!

Of course. Here's a list of guests for you.

First, it's Timofey Gromov, a distinguished druid. He might look gloomy and thoughtful, but he is a true druid, very skillful. Kanians and Gibberlings adore his magic of Nature. Who knows, may be we have a chance to see a miracle...

Second, it's Pakhom Rogov, construction council agent. He's not very widely known, but he's pretty, so the ladies here are going to love him. We're making up a legend for him now, you know, for the ladies.

The third and the last one is Vladimir Zalesky, the League commander. A real hero, a legend for kids, he's got a few stories to tell, for sure.

Do you have any questions? No? Then I'm hoping to see all the guests here soon!

Is that meat? Looks disgusting. And stinks, too. Let me have some... What are you staring at? My bro once tried to eat an Astral demon. Imagine, how hungry he was! It's a pity he couldn't. The demon fell into ashes!

Listen up now. The lion is as moody as a grumpy old man. One minute, he's calm, another minute, he roars and charges at you! So, you need to soothe him first, if you want to feed him.

If you see he's falling asleep, find courage, work up your nerve and roar at him! That'll wake him up, for sure! Don't overdo it, though. If he's too annoyed, you will have to talk to him mildly to pacify him.

As soon as he's calm, not too sleepy, not too annoyed - it's high time to feed him all your steaks. Come back to me, when you have it done.

You have brought the meat? Excellent. Hm, looks good enough... I think.

Now, our lion is as moody as a grumpy old man. One minute, he's calm, another minute, he roars and charges at you! So, you need to soothe him first, if you want to feed him.

If you see he's falling asleep, find courage, work up your nerve and roar at him! That'll wake him up, for sure! Don't overdo it, though. If he's too annoyed, you will have to talk to him mildly to pacify him, like a baby. As soon as he's calm, it's high time to feed him all your steaks. Come back to me, when you've finished.
We're having a party here! Don't go too far from here.
Flowers, and tapestry, and musicians! Just imagine, how beautiful it all will be!
Nochee tluckamay wan siuamei keepeei manoy kooaly tluckateesay!
It's not easy to handle this one!
The final fight is the toughest one!
Looks like this time we'll have to save the world by ourselves. Unless you decide to flee, of course. In that case I'll make it alone!
Looks like the world needs saving once again... You with me?
So much effort! Finally, we'll find out whatever he has predicted!
How come you can't see him? He's right there. Squint your eyes, bow your head, wink... See him now?
Yes, I've found an alternative option... However, touching it gives me the creeps.
Yes, the Wand is ripe. It is glowing... With darkness. I've seen a lot, but this stuff makes my skin crawl.

Hey, what the hell! What kind of help is it? One assistant is clumsier than the other! One carries bits of astralium in his pockets and then complains about some outgrowth. Another one tried to use the seventh page of the Great Mage's Diary to kindle a fire. The third... May he rest in peace... Argh! I've found the translator, here it is. Don't lose it again!

A new one? You think there's another thing like that in Sarnaut? I hope not! How can one lose such items at all? Can you imagine what can happen if it gets into the wrong hands? Luckily, I noticed it and picked it up. Here, take it and don't lose it again!

What?! That's the only prototype! Where am I going to get another one?
Consider yourself lucky that, while some keep losing unique devices, others find them. Here it is. And see that you don't drop it again!

A new one? You think there's another thing like that in Sarnaut? I hope not! How can one lose such items at all? Can you imagine what can happen if it gets into the wrong hands? Luckily, I noticed it and picked it up. Here, take it and don't lose it again!
Just don't pass out. It's not exactly an optimistic picture.
Alright. You have completed the trial.
As you say. I can see you know no greed.
Here you go, don’t lose it next time.
